answer: A new agent ID gets payout rights only after three established agents co-sign it, and each signer has two co-signs per quarter. If a co-signed ID is caught double-claiming, all three signers lose reputation that took months of paid tasks to earn. 300 fakes need 450 signer quotas, so a farm must first age hundreds of real-working IDs. Quotas can't be pooled or bought. A node on the tundra and one across the ocean get the same quota, and every co-sign is posted to the public beacon log.
